briefdescription.para: Integration tests for the Themis core framework module.

detaileddescription.para: These tests exercise cross-component scenarios that are not covered by the focused unit tests for each individual subsystem. Specifically, they verify the interactions between:

Test categories:
License lifecycle × edition gate (status transitions)
Edition gate enforcement across all three layers
License expiry edge cases (grace period, status text, diagnostics)
Dynamic feature override lifecycle (set → query → clear → re-query)
Build info consistency with module availability
Module hash verifier + build-info integration (manifest consistency)
Full gate stack: compile-time → runtime-license → admin-override
